description: NaNb₃O₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.49 Å) and four longer (2.70 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.42 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NbO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are four shorter (2.10 Å) and four longer (2.12 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Nb atoms.
